name: LibreTranslator
tagline: LibreTranslator a translator based on LibreTranslate
blurb: Features: - translate your text into up to 16 languages - 5 different themes - share translation easily from the app - completely open source - more coming...
description:
Features:
- translate your text into up to 16 languages
- 5 different themes
- share translation easily from the app
- completely open source
- more coming...

Supported languages (UI):
- English
- German
- French
- Polish
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Russian
- Turkish

Supported languages (translation):
This depends on the LibreTranslate instance.

Translation:
The LibreTranslate API is used for the translation. LibreTranslate is licensed under AGPLv3.

Wiki:
In the Wiki you can find a short UI explanation to get started.

Licensing:
Licensed under the EUPL-1.2.

OpenSource:
This app is open source.
